target_customer: Consumers in New York City ordering food for fast delivery
problem: Food delivery took 30 to 60 minutes; Racer promised delivery in 15 minutes.
business_model: On-demand delivery with delivery fees and food margin (model not detailed in sources)

competitors.name: Gopuff
competitors.what: Instant delivery of convenience goods; launched 30-minute delivery in New York City in 2020
competitors.funding_then: $380M round at a $3.9B valuation announced October 2020

technical_complexity.rationale: Courier dispatch and ordering apps are standard, but guaranteeing 15-minute delivery needs logistics and local operations.

defensibility.rationale: Speed is an operations promise that larger delivery players could match with capital; no network or regulatory moat is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: In 2021 and 2022 many 15-minute delivery firms entered New York; DoorDash briefly tried 15-minute delivery there and exited per trade coverage.

market_need_then: No dated demand evidence for Racer itself was found; 15-minute delivery demand in New York is described in 2021 coverage, after the batch.

branding.domain_note: Used racer.app; the domain did not resolve from this research environment, so its current state is unknown.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand assets about Racer were found; its name does not appear in 15-minute delivery coverage.

outcome_analysis: Racer was a seven-person New York 15-minute food delivery startup in Summer 2020 and is now Inactive. No shutdown report or founder statement was found, so the cause is not public and no failure factors are assigned. Industry coverage shows other 15-minute delivery firms struggled in 2022 with high costs, but that is context, not a sourced cause for Racer.
notes: The $500K convertible note and investors rest on a single database (CB Insights) with no date; stage recorded as other (convertible note). CB Insights also gives a Seattle address versus New York on the YC page. racer.app could not be fetched (host did not resolve in this environment), so site status is unverified. Gopuff source is dated October 2020, about two months after the Summer 2020 batch. Fast grocery rivals Gorillas, Jokr, Buyk and Fridge No More launched in New York in 2021, after the batch, so they are excluded. A Shyft listing describes a different Racer product, treated as unrelated. Cause of Inactive status is not public.
